comment: Dr. Cobbs is very nice and enthusiastic about the subject she is teaching. That being said, this class is not an easy A. You are expected to read the bible in its entirety. Tests are extremely difficult and the review sheets do not match what you are being tested on.
Absolutely LOVED Dr. Cobb. Amazing teacher and person. Will definitely be taking again.

I could not say enough good things about Dr. Cobb! She is so passionate and honest about her focus subject, and I found her very inspiring. She is very fair with her grading and expects that you respect her assignments and put college level effort into them. She makes class interactive and expects  participation.

Professor Cobb is a very knowledgeable professor who holds very intriguing lectures and cares about her students. BUT she has extremely unrealistic expectations of her students when it comes to interpreting theological passages, along with writing papers. I am a A student -  and a sophomore. This class was the hardest I had all year.

SO NICE. TAKE HER. Seriously the best teacher I have had here so far, super understanding and accepts a ton of feedback, she revised the syllabus just because people in my class wanted the class to go slower. Really passionate about what she does and she's so smart. Midterm and final were take home and open note. She is also really funny.
Dr.Cobb is by far my favorite professor! So passionate about what she teaches and has made such a big impact on me. Take her if you have the opportunity, you won't regret it!!

This class is great if you're willing to do a lot of reading and discussions. Make sure you read ALL the directions for assignments or your grade will reflect it. The overall grade depends a lot on two papers, but she gave us a chance to revise the first one after giving us feedback. Don't take if you're not willing to put in the work.

Class was low-key a waste of time, you go and discuss your thoughts with your group.
Your grade depends heavily on two papers and she is a tough grader, no joke worst professor at UR

This class was ridiculous and terrible! She is such a hard grader and if you are an international student good luck with that. She presents a lot of false information and she hates it when you disagree with her.
I regret this class, if you are trying to get your history credit avoid this class at all costs!

If you are a history/religion major (and great at writing), this is a great elective class to take. If you just looking to fulfill the gen. ed. requirement, I would advise looking at other classes to fulfill this requirement. Dr.Cobb was an incredibly hard grader on the papers which is worth a major part of the overall grade.

took this class for a gen ed. she is really nice and passionate, but the class is disgustingly boring. painful. we sit in groups of 4 for the entire class, waiting for her to come around to talk to us about the reading. other than those 15 minutes talking to her, you literally do nothing. I also hate the topic so.

This class was amazing. There was never a day I would come to class and be not excited and eager to learn something new. Dr. Cobb does a wonderful job of making complicated concepts/ interpretations easy to understand. She always challenged my thinking to make me think more critically about the material in which I was engaging with! Love her and he
Great and understanding professor. She creates the perfect class and cares for her students!

Definitely take her class if you can. Gods of Pharaohs is a great class to take to fulfill the english gen ed. Every class is small group discussion on the reading which is usually interesting. There are only two short papers the whole semester.

Dr. Cobb is seriously awesome. Her courses are incredibly interesting, and the course work makes sense and actually helps with learning. If you're considering taking one of her courses, absolutely go for it.

Dr. Cobb is AMAZING. I've taken her three times now, in everything from gen-ed classes to upper level seminars. She is absolutely brilliant and obviously passionate about her field. She's very clear about her expectations and as long as you read the syllabus, do the readings, follow along, and turn things in on time, you'll be fine. LOVE HER!

Dr. Cobb is so enthusiastic about the material, how could you not enjoy her class? You learn a lot, and the workload is manageable. Take her for your FHST or if you are simply interested in religious history.

Dr. Cobb is a wonderful teacher and mentor who really appreciates people who take a genuine interest in her class. Her classes aren't exactly easy but she does her best to share her passion for religion with her students. She is also brilliant and respected in her field.

She does not teach the class. She assigns reading, has you discuss with a small group about topics that she provides and then expects you to come up with things to talk about as the semester goes on. Out of all the papers we wrote, only one was connected to the class and it was the final paper so it was really hard to know what to do.

Really enjoyed the subject material of the class, although it may be boring for some. She really wants students to succeed and will help you in any way she can. This class was almost entirely discussion based, so participation is important.
Dr. Cobb is a fascinating person but I found her hard to follow as a professor. I felt like I put in maximum amount of effort but never got the grades I was expecting. She is a very hard grader.
Her class definitely isn't easy, but she makes the class interesting.  She is helpful outside of class; she cares about all of her students.  I want to take any classes with her that I can!
Hard grader. Doesn't like you to disagree with her.

She is passionate about what she teaches and allows the students to decide what will happen in class, except for a few quizzes.  Do your thinking exercises, and reading,  and participate during class and you will do fine. I didn't participate enough in class and my grade suffered.

Very straightforward in what she expects from you. Just do the thinking exercises every night since they're a bulk of your grade and you'll be fine. The reading is really not that bad either. Her papers reflect everything discussed in class. Just participate and pay attention!
Not a hard grader when it comes to papers and homework. Ready and able to address all questions. For an older lady, not bad to look at. Never had to sit in class for exams!
She is a hard grader. Don't expect her to help you
